meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 装上后,当用户给出产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简报时,Claude 会确认简报、抓取页面素材并提取品牌色与字体,接着写分镜脚本,逐帧生成 HTML 画面,最后渲染成 mp4 宣传视频。
howto.when: 当用户想宣传、发布或推广某个产品,并给出网址、粘贴的脚本或简报时触发;网站导览/展示也走这里,商业网址默认如此;意图不清晰时转交 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这个产品页做成一支宣传片:https://example.com
say.note: Claude 会先抓取页面素材,再进入分镜流程。

say.text: 按我粘贴的新产品文案做一支功能上线视频。
say.note: 没有网址时会走无抓取路径,只用这段文案。

say.text: 把这几张网站截图做成按原样展示的导览视频。
say.note: 网站展示类需求也归本技能,以截图为画面依据。

howto.what_en: Given a URL, pasted script, or brief, Claude captures assets or uses the supplied text, extracts brand tokens, writes a storyboard/script, builds one HTML per frame, and renders an MP4 promo video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to market/launch/promote a product through a URL, pasted script, or brief, or asks to showcase a website as-is; unclear intent routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this product page into a promo video: https://example.com
say_en.note: Claude captures the page assets first, then storyboards.

say_en.text: Use the launch copy I just pasted to make a feature-reveal video.
say_en.note: No URL present, so it follows the no-capture path.

say_en.text: Turn these website screenshots into an as-is site tour video.
say_en.note: Site tour requests route here; screenshots drive the visuals.
